_about: The Inn map (explore/inn-map.js): the ground floor, drawn in a 340 x 330 box. Content and art edit this file. go = the ROOMS key the room walks to; a room whose go isn't built yet shows its 'soon' line and can't be entered. Keep each line short (two lines of about 18 letters at 375 px). shape = [x, y, width, height]; upright: the name runs up the room; at = where the name sits, if not the middle.
title: The Inn
sub: Tap a room to walk there.
